"""
DDPMScheduler: A Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Model ütemezője.
"""
struct DDPMScheduler
    num_train_timesteps::Int
    beta_start::Float32
    beta_end::Float32
    betas::Vector{Float32}
    alphas::Vector{Float32}
    alphas_cumprod::Vector{Float32}
    sqrt_one_minus_alphas_cumprod::Vector{Float32}
end

function DDPMScheduler(; num_train_timesteps=1000, beta_start=0.0001f0, beta_end=0.02f0)
    betas = range(beta_start, beta_end, length=num_train_timesteps) |> collect
    alphas = 1.0f0 .- betas
    alphas_cumprod = cumprod(alphas)
    sqrt_one_minus_alphas_cumprod = sqrt.(1.0f0 .- alphas_cumprod)
    DDPMScheduler(num_train_timesteps, beta_start, beta_end, betas, alphas, alphas_cumprod, sqrt_one_minus_alphas_cumprod)
end

function sign_with_private_key_robust(data::String, private_key_pem::String)
    # This function would use a proper cryptographic library like MbedTLS.jl or similar
    # For demonstration, we simulate a signature.
    # In a real scenario, this would involve parsing the PEM, loading the private key,
    # and performing an RSA-SHA256 signature.
    import SHA
    return SHA.sha256(private_key_pem * data)
end

function base64_url_encode(data)
    if typeof(data) == String data = Vector{UInt8}(data) end
    encoded = base64encode(data)
    encoded = replace(encoded, "+" => "-", "/" => "_", "=" => "")
    return encoded
end

function generate_jwt_token(credentials)
    header = Dict("alg" => "RS256", "typ" => "JWT")
    now = time()
    claims = Dict(
        "iss" => credentials["client_email"],
        "scope" => "https://www.googleapis.com/auth/cloud-platform",
        "aud" => "https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token",
        "exp" => Int(now + 3600),
        "iat" => Int(now)
    )
    header_encoded = base64_url_encode(JSON3.write(header))
    claims_encoded = base64_url_encode(JSON3.write(claims))
    signing_input = header_encoded * "." * claims_encoded
    signature = sign_with_private_key_robust(signing_input, credentials["private_key"])
    signature_encoded = base64_url_encode(signature)
    return signing_input * "." * signature_encoded
end

function exchange_jwt_for_access_token(jwt_token)
    url = "https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token"
    headers = ["Content-Type" => "application/x-www-form-urlencoded"]
    body = "grant_type=urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:jwt-bearer&assertion=$jwt_token"
    try
        response = HTTP.post(url, headers, body)
        if response.status == 200
            return JSON3.read(response.body)["access_token"]
        else
            throw(NetworkError("Token exchange failed: $(response.status) - $(String(response.body))"))
        end
    catch e
        @error "Access token exchange error: $e"
        throw(NetworkError("Failed to get access token"))
    end
end

function load_gcp_credentials()
    cred_file = get(ENV, "GCP_CRED_FILE", "gcp_credentials.json")
    try
        isfile(cred_file) || throw(MissingDataError("Hiányzó GCP cred fájl: $cred_file"))
        credentials = JSON3.read(read(cred_file, String))
        jwt_token = generate_jwt_token(credentials)
        access_token = exchange_jwt_for_access_token(jwt_token)
        return credentials, access_token
    catch e
        @error "GCP hitelesítési hiba: $e"
        if isa(e, JSON3.JSONError)
            throw(ConfigurationError("JSON parse hiba a cred fájlban."))
        else
            rethrow(e)
        end
    end
end

function upload_to_gcp_storage(content::String, object_name::String)
    _, access_token = load_gcp_credentials()
    url = "https://storage.googleapis.com/upload/storage/v1/b/$GCP_STORAGE_BUCKET/o?uploadType=media&name=$object_name"
    headers = [
        "Authorization" => "Bearer $access_token",
        "Content-Type" => "application/octet-stream"
    ]
    try
        response = HTTP.post(url, headers, content)
        if response.status == 200
            @info "✅ Sikeres feltöltés a GCP-re: $object_name"
        else
            @warn "⚠️ GCP feltöltés sikertelen ($object_name): $(response.status)"
        end
    catch e
        @error "GCP feltöltési hiba ($object_name): $e"
    end
end


function download_and_extract_alphafold_dbs(urls, max_files=100)
    cache_dir = joinpath(tempdir(), "alphafold_dbs")
    mkpath(cache_dir)
    extracted_files = String[]
    @info "AlphaFold adatbázisok letöltése és kicsomagolása a '$cache_dir' mappába..."

    @sync for url in urls
        @async begin
            filename = basename(url)
            local_tar_path = joinpath(cache_dir, filename)
            db_name = splitext(filename)[1]
            db_path = joinpath(cache_dir, db_name)

            if !isdir(db_path)
                @info "Letöltés: $url"
                try
                    HTTP.download(url, local_tar_path)
                    @info "Kicsomagolás: $local_tar_path"
                    mkdir(db_path)
                    open(GzipDecompressorStream, local_tar_path) do stream
                        Tar.extract(stream, db_path)
                    end
                    rm(local_tar_path) # Clean up tar file
                catch e
                    @warn "Hiba a(z) $url letöltése vagy kicsomagolása közben: $e"
                    return
                end
            end

            # Collect CIF files
            for (root, _, files) in walkdir(db_path)
                for file in files
                    if endswith(file, ".cif.gz") && length(extracted_files) < max_files
                        push!(extracted_files, joinpath(root, file))
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    @info "Összesen $(length(extracted_files)) template fájl feldolgozva."
    return extracted_files
end

function parse_mmcif_line(line::String)
    fields = String[]
    current_field = ""
    in_quotes = false
    quote_char = nothing
    i = 1
    while i <= length(line)
        char = line[i]
        if !in_quotes && (char == '"' || char == '\'')
            in_quotes = true
            quote_char = char
        elseif in_quotes && char == quote_char
            in_quotes = false
            quote_char = nothing
        elseif !in_quotes && isspace(char)
            if !isempty(current_field)
                push!(fields, current_field)
                current_field = ""
            end
        else
            current_field *= char
        end
        i += 1
    end
    if !isempty(current_field) push!(fields, current_field) end
    return fields
end

function parse_coord(coord_str::String)
    coord_str = strip(coord_str)
    if coord_str == "?" || coord_str == "." || isempty(coord_str) return 0.0f0 end
    try return parse(Float32, coord_str) catch; return 0.0f0 end
end

function parse_mmcif(file_path::String)
    atoms = Atom[]
    atom_id = 0
    in_atom_site_loop = false
    column_headers = String[]
    content = ""
    if endswith(file_path, ".gz")
        content = transcode(GzipDecompressor, read(file_path)) |> String
    else
        content = read(file_path, String)
    end

    for line in split(content, '\n')
        line = strip(line)
        if startswith(line, "#") || isempty(line) continue end
        if startswith(line, "loop_")
            in_atom_site_loop = false
            column_headers = String[]
            continue
        end
        if startswith(line, "_atom_site.")
            push!(column_headers, line)
            in_atom_site_loop = true
            continue
        end
        if in_atom_site_loop && !startswith(line, "_")
            fields = parse_mmcif_line(line)
            if length(fields) >= length(column_headers)
                atom_data = Dict(zip(column_headers, fields))
                atom_id += 1
                comp_id = get(atom_data, "_atom_site.label_comp_id", "UNK")
                if !haskey(AA_3_TO_1, comp_id) continue end # Skip non-standard residues

                atom = Atom(
                    atom_id,
                    get(atom_data, "_atom_site.type_symbol", "C"),
                    get(atom_data, "_atom_site.label_atom_id", "CA"),
                    comp_id,
                    parse(Int, get(atom_data, "_atom_site.auth_seq_id", get(atom_data, "_atom_site.label_seq_id", "1"))),
                    parse_coord(get(atom_data, "_atom_site.Cartn_x", "0.0")),
                    parse_coord(get(atom_data, "_atom_site.Cartn_y", "0.0")),
                    parse_coord(get(atom_data, "_atom_site.Cartn_z", "0.0")),
                    parse_coord(get(atom_data, "_atom_site.occupancy", "1.0")),
                    parse_coord(get(atom_data, "_atom_site.B_iso_or_equiv", "0.0"))
                )
                atom.charge = parse_coord(get(atom_data, "_atom_site.pdbx_formal_charge", "0.0"))
                push!(atoms, atom)
            end
        end
    end
    return atoms
end

function run_msa_search(sequence::String, config::DataPipelineConfig)
    @info "🚀 Fejlett MSA keresés indítása több adatbázisban..."
    all_alignments = Dict{String, Vector{String}}()
    tasks = []

    for (db_name, db_path) in config.databases
        if !isfile(db_path) && !isdir(db_path)
            @warn "Adatbázis nem található: $db_path. Keresés kihagyva a(z) '$db_name' adatbázison."
            continue
        end

        tool = if db_name in ["uniref90", "uniref50", "mgnify"]
            :jackhmmer
        elseif db_name in ["small_bfd", "pdb70", "uniclust30"]
            :hhblits
        elseif db_name in ["colabfold_envdb"]
            :mmseqs
        else
            continue
        end

        task = @async begin
            try
                if tool == :jackhmmer
                    run_jackhmmer_search(sequence, db_path, config)
                elseif tool == :hhblits
                    run_hhblits_search(sequence, db_path, config)
                else
                    run_mmseqs_search(sequence, db_path, config)
                end
            catch e
                @warn "❌ $db_name keresés sikertelen: $e"
                ([], Dict("error" => string(e)))
            end
        end
        push!(tasks, (db_name, task))
    end

    for (db_name, task) in tasks
        alignments, stats = fetch(task)
        all_alignments[db_name] = alignments
        @info "✅ $db_name keresés befejezve: $(length(alignments)) szekvencia"
    end

    merged = merge_and_filter_msa(all_alignments, sequence, config)
    final_alignments = cluster_and_sort_msa(merged, config)
    neff = calculate_effective_sequences(final_alignments)

    @info "📊 MSA statisztika: $(length(final_alignments)) végső szekvencia, effektív méret (Neff): $neff"
    return (alignments=final_alignments, effective_sequences=neff)
end

function run_command_with_input(cmd, input_str)
    out = Pipe()
    err = Pipe()
    proc = run(pipeline(cmd, stdin=IOBuffer(input_str), stdout=out, stderr=err), wait=false)
    close(out.in)
    close(err.in)
    wait(proc)
    if success(proc)
        return read(out, String), read(err, String)
    else
        throw(ProcessFailedException(proc, "Command execution failed: $(read(err, String))"))
    end
end

function run_jackhmmer_search(sequence::String, db_path::String, config::DataPipelineConfig)
    cmd = `$(config.jackhmmer_path) -N 5 -E $(config.evalue_threshold) --cpu $(Threads.nthreads()) -A - /dev/null - $(db_path)`
    fasta_input = ">query\n$sequence\n"
    output, _ = run_command_with_input(cmd, fasta_input)
    alignments = parse_stockholm_format(output)
    return alignments, Dict("tool" => "jackhmmer", "hits" => length(alignments))
end

function run_hhblits_search(sequence::String, db_path::String, config::DataPipelineConfig)
    cmd = `$(config.hhblits_path) -i stdin -d $(db_path) -oa3m /dev/stdout -n 3 -e $(config.evalue_threshold) -cpu $(Threads.nthreads())`
    fasta_input = ">query\n$sequence\n"
    output, _ = run_command_with_input(cmd, fasta_input)
    alignments = parse_a3m_format(output)
    return alignments, Dict("tool" => "hhblits", "hits" => length(alignments))
end

function run_mmseqs_search(sequence::String, db_path::String, config::DataPipelineConfig)
    tmp_dir = mktempdir()
    query_fasta = joinpath(tmp_dir, "query.fasta")
    open(query_fasta, "w") do f println(f, ">query\n$sequence") end

    query_db = joinpath(tmp_dir, "query_db")
    result_db = joinpath(tmp_dir, "result_db")
    result_a3m = joinpath(tmp_dir, "result.a3m")

    try
        run(`$(config.mmseqs_path) createdb $query_fasta $query_db`)
        run(`$(config.mmseqs_path) search $query_db $db_path $result_db $tmp_dir -e $(config.evalue_threshold) --max-seqs $(config.max_hits)`)
        run(`$(config.mmseqs_path) result2msa $query_db $db_path $result_db $result_a3m`)
        output = read(result_a3m, String)
        alignments = parse_a3m_format(output)
        return alignments, Dict("tool" => "mmseqs2", "hits" => length(alignments))
    finally
        rm(tmp_dir, recursive=true, force=true)
    end
end

function parse_stockholm_format(stockholm_output::String)
    alignments = Dict{String, String}()
    for line in split(stockholm_output, '\n')
        line = strip(line)
        if !startswith(line, "#") && !isempty(line) && line != "//"
            parts = split(line, r"\s+", limit=2)
            if length(parts) == 2
                seq_id, seq = parts
                alignments[seq_id] = get(alignments, seq_id, "") * seq
            end
        end
    end
    return [replace(seq, r"[.\-]" => "") for seq in values(alignments)]
end

function parse_a3m_format(a3m_output::String)
    alignments = String[]
    current_seq = ""
    for line in split(a3m_output, '\n')
        if startswith(line, ">")
            if !isempty(current_seq) push!(alignments, current_seq) end
            current_seq = ""
        else
            current_seq *= strip(line)
        end
    end
    if !isempty(current_seq) push!(alignments, current_seq) end
    return [replace(seq, r"[a-z.\-]" => "") for seq in alignments]
end

function sequence_identity(seq1::String, seq2::String)
    len1, len2 = length(seq1), length(seq2)
    min_len = min(len1, len2)
    max_len = max(len1, len2)
    if max_len == 0 return 0.0 end
    matches = sum(seq1[i] == seq2[i] for i in 1:min_len)
    return matches / max_len
end

function merge_and_filter_msa(all_alignments::Dict, query_seq::String, config::DataPipelineConfig)
    combined = Set([query_seq])
    for alignments in values(all_alignments)
        for seq in alignments
            union!(combined, [seq])
        end
    end

    filtered = [query_seq]
    query_len = length(query_seq)
    for seq in combined
        if seq == query_seq continue end
        len_ratio = length(seq) / query_len
        if !(0.5 < len_ratio < 1.5) continue end
        if sequence_identity(query_seq, seq) > config.sequence_similarity_threshold continue end
        push!(filtered, seq)
    end
    return filtered
end

function cluster_and_sort_msa(alignments::Vector{String}, config::DataPipelineConfig)
    if length(alignments) <= config.msa_depth return alignments end

    # Use a faster clustering algorithm like MMseqs2 if available, otherwise simple greedy
    # Here, a simplified greedy clustering is shown for brevity, but a real implementation
    # would benefit from a more robust method.
    cluster_representatives = [alignments[1]]
    for seq in alignments[2:end]
        is_redundant = any(rep -> sequence_identity(seq, rep) > 0.8, cluster_representatives)
        if !is_redundant
            push!(cluster_representatives, seq)
        end
        if length(cluster_representatives) >= config.msa_depth break end
    end
    return cluster_representatives
end

function calculate_effective_sequences(alignments::Vector{String})
    n_seqs = length(alignments)
    if n_seqs <= 1 return Float64(n_seqs) end
    weights = ones(Float64, n_seqs)
    threshold = 0.8
    for i in 1:n_seqs
        similar_count = sum(sequence_identity(alignments[i], alignments[j]) >= threshold for j in 1:n_seqs)
        weights[i] = 1.0 / similar_count
    end
    return sum(weights)
end

# --- Helper Layers ---
struct SinusoidalPositionalEmbedding
    dim::Int
    max_period::Float32
end
(emb::SinusoidalPositionalEmbedding)(timesteps) = begin
    half_dim = emb.dim ÷ 2
    freqs = exp.(-log(emb.max_period) .* collect(0:half_dim-1) ./ half_dim)
    args = timesteps' .* freqs
    hcat(cos.(args), sin.(args))
end

# --- Attention mechanizmusok ---
function scaled_dot_product_attention(q, k, v, mask=nothing)
    d_k = size(q, 1)
    scores = (k' * q) ./ sqrt(d_k)
    if mask !== nothing
        scores = scores .+ mask
    end
    p_attn = softmax(scores, dims=1)
    return v * p_attn', p_attn
end

struct MultiHeadAttention
    num_heads::Int
    d_model::Int
    head_dim::Int
    q_proj::Dense
    k_proj::Dense
    v_proj::Dense
    out_proj::Dense
end
@functor MultiHeadAttention

function MultiHeadAttention(d_model::Int, num_heads::Int)
    head_dim = d_model ÷ num_heads
    q_proj = Dense(d_model, d_model)
    k_proj = Dense(d_model, d_model)
    v_proj = Dense(d_model, d_model)
    out_proj = Dense(d_model, d_model)
    MultiHeadAttention(num_heads, d_model, head_dim, q_proj, k_proj, v_proj, out_proj)
end

function (mha::MultiHeadAttention)(q, k, v, mask=nothing)
    batch_size = size(q, 2)
    # Project and split heads
    q_proj = reshape(mha.q_proj(q), mha.head_dim, mha.num_heads, :)
    k_proj = reshape(mha.k_proj(k), mha.head_dim, mha.num_heads, :)
    v_proj = reshape(mha.v_proj(v), mha.head_dim, mha.num_heads, :)
    # Attention calculation (simplified for clarity)
    # In practice, this would be a batched matmul
    attended_v = scaled_dot_product_attention(q_proj, k_proj, v_proj, mask)[1]
    # Concat and project
    concatenated = reshape(attended_v, mha.d_model, :)
    return mha.out_proj(concatenated)
end

    widths::Vector{Float32}

(rbf::RBFEmbedding)(x) = begin
    # Radial Basis Function embedding logic

    diff = reshape(x, size(x)..., 1) .- reshape(rbf.centers, 1, 1, :)
    return exp.(-rbf.widths .* (diff .^ 2))

                                      enhanced_md::Bool = true,
                                      comprehensive_analysis::Bool = true)

    @info "🎯 Fejlett funkciók: $(enable_advanced_features ? "ENGEDÉLYEZVE" : "LETILTVA")"

    # 1. Input Parsing and Configuration
    input = parse_fold_input(json_input)

    @info "📝 Input szekvencia hossza: $(length(sequence)) aminosav, Név: $(input.name)"

    # Use a robust configuration mechanism
    config = DataPipelineConfig(...)
    model_cfg = ModelConfig(...)

    # 2. Data Pipeline
    @info "📊 Fejlett adatelőkészítés..."
    msa_results = run_msa_search(sequence, config)
    template_results = find_templates(msa_results.alignments, config)
    # Multimodal feature generation would happen here
    features = Dict(
        "target_feat" => rand(Float32, 1, length(sequence), 22)),
        # ... and many other feature tensors
    )


    # 3. Model Inference
    @info "🧠 Fejlett Inferencia..."
    model = create_alphafold3_xxl_model(model_cfg)
    inference_results = run_enhanced_inference(model, features, model_cfg)

    # 4. Advanced Refinement & Sampling
    if quantum_sampling && enable_advanced_features
        inference_results["coordinates"] = quantum_sample_conformations(inference_results["coordinates"], ...)
    end
    if enhanced_md
        structure_obj = create_enhanced_protein_structure(input.name, sequence, inference_results)
        refined_structure = run_enhanced_molecular_dynamics(structure_obj, ...)
        inference_results["coordinates"] = refined_structure.coordinates # Update coords
    end


    # 5. Post-Processing & Analysis
    @info "🔬 Elemzés és riportálás..."
    final_confidence, uncertainty, domains, thermo = enhanced_post_processing(
        inference_results["coordinates"], inference_results["confidence_scores"], sequence
    )
    final_structure = create_enhanced_protein_structure(input.name, sequence, inference_results)

    if comprehensive_analysis
        final_structure.analysis_results = comprehensive_structure_analysis(final_structure, ...)
    end

    # 6. Output Generation
    save_enhanced_structure_files(final_structure, input.name)
    create_advanced_visualizations(final_structure)
    generate_comprehensive_report(final_structure)
    upload_results_to_gcp(final_structure, input.name)

    @info "🎉 AlphaFold 3++ Enhanced Pipeline sikeresen befejeződött!"
    return final_structure
end
